items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I said, “No! No, Joe! Salad. Salad!”

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s a brass cup, and it’s ginger beer, lemon and lime, and ice. Oh! In the summer, that’s a killer. They call it Moscow Mule. And he made the greatest steaks. I’m in there earlier, but I’m coming out of the bathroom... My brother doesn’t know that I’m in there, and I hear him walk in. He goes, “Joe, let me have one of those incredible, delicious, thick steaks that you have.” Then all of a sudden I hear them, but I don’t know... So I come running out. I said, “No! No, Joe! Salad. Salad!” He goes, “Oh, yeah,…
